section-78-1.TO: — (a) do an act, or (b) omit to do an act that they are required to do by any enactment or rule of law
section-78-1.WHERE: the person intends that their act or omission will have a consequence mentioned in paragraph (b) or is reckless as to whether it will have such a consequence
section-78-1.UNLESS: this relates to — (a) any act or omission which occurred before the coming into force of subsection (1), or (b) any act or omission which began before the coming into force of subsection (1) and continues after its coming into force

section-78-3.FOR: a person charged with an offence under subsection (1)
section-78-3.TO: prove that they had a reasonable excuse for the act or omission mentioned in paragraph (a) of that subsection
section-78-3.UNLESS: this relates to — (a) any act or omission which occurred before the coming into force of those subsections, or (b) any act or omission which began before the coming into force of those subsections and continues after their coming into force
